Kenji says FIFO margin for September was way below what our dashboard shows. Our avg paid is right isn't it? explain to me like I'm not an accountant why they'd differ

They answer different questions. Avg paid (180d) is a simple average of the weekly buy-list price — every week counts once no matter how much you bought. FIFO uses what you actually paid for the specific units you sold, oldest first. If you bought a lot at a high price recently and then cut the buy list, the average drops fast but the units on the shelf were still bought at the high price. So FIFO margin is lower. Both are 'right'; they're just different definitions.
ok so which one do I tell Sam
Tell Sam both, labelled. For 'are we making money', the books use FIFO.
